# Bundled Alpine.js

The PWA bundles Alpine.js 3.17.4 in `alpine.min.js` so game screens work offline.

Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.17.4/dist/cdn.min.js`

SHA-256: `232519394c6c8fdba6f362b1d9da16106db513cdbf899011f00daab4051df31c`

The MIT license is in `ALPINE-LICENSE.md`. This file is vendored, so an `npm audit` result does not cover it. Review Alpine releases and advisories when updating the app.
